p1: [low, ominous] Security cameras filmed him walking into a bar. [whispers] Not one camera... ever saw him walk out.
[low] Columbus, Ohio. April, two thousand six. [low, tense] Brian Shaffer. Twenty-seven. A medical student.
[low] His mother had died three weeks earlier. [low] In two days, he was flying to Miami... with his girlfriend.
[low, tense] Just after one a.m., a camera filmed him riding the escalator up to the bar.
[low] Just before two, he was on camera again. [low, tense] Talking with two women.
[low] The bar closed at two. His friends waited outside. [whispers] He never came out.
[low, tense] Police went through the footage. [low, ominous] Not one frame shows him leaving.
[low] The only other way out... was a service door. [whispers] Nobody knows if he used it.
[low, tense] Months later, his phone briefly came back on. [whispers] The phone company called it... a glitch.
[low, ominous] Twenty years later, Brian Shaffer has never been found.
[low] He walked into that bar... [whispers] and never walked out.
